Official contact with Russia should remain suspended, and the Arctic 7 could then adopt the model exemplified by the Barents Euro-Arctic Council, which has strengthened practical cooperation measures in Russia’s absence.64 Projects involving Russia should remain paused until Moscow is ready to reverse its aggression against Ukraine and to engage in good faith in the polar regions, rather than weaponizing Arctic exceptionalism for its coercive ends.
